pattern_explanation: These Portuguese words look similar to English words such as library, assist, pretend, and exquisite, but their meanings differ because each language developed its own sense for the shared root.
false_friend_warning: Warning: the Portuguese word livraria looks like the English word library, but it means bookshop, not library. Other look-alikes, such as assistir (not assist) and pretender (not pretend), also have different meanings.
